arguments.summary: A mass credential compromise was initiated from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith in the Finance department. The incident began with a Cobalt Strike beacon (detected via IDS signature ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity) making outbound HTTPS connections to a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23). Subsequent activity included suspicious process execution (rundll32 from Temp), failed Kerberos TGT requests, and successful lateral movement via SMB to internal file server 10.0.5.50. The source IP in the alert (10.0.5.14) appears to be a misattribution; all forensic evidence points to 10.0.5.42 as the true origin. Immediate containment actions successfully blocked outbound traffic from the compromised host. No malicious payload was found in the sandboxed sample, but behavioral logs confirm adversarial tactics.
